definitions.explanation: To perceive the flavor of food or drink, often appreciatively.
To undergo or feel an experience, emotion, or sensation deeply.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}をゆっくり{味|あじ}わって{食|た}べる。
examples.english: Eat the food slowly and savor it.

examples.japanese: この{ワイン}の{香|かお}りを{味|あじ}わってください。
examples.english: Please savor the aroma of this wine.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}の{喜|よろこ}びを{味|あじ}わった。
examples.english: I experienced the joy of success.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{味|あじ}わう (to taste/experience X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing appreciation. {味|あじ}わっている = 'is savoring.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {料理|りょうり}を{味|あじ}わう (to savor food)
- {人生|じんせい}を{味|あじ}わう (to experience life)
- {苦|くる}しみを{味|あじ}わう (to experience suffering)
- {喜|よろこ}びを{味|あじ}わう (to experience joy)
- {味|あじ}わい{深|ぶか}い (full of flavor/depth)

NUANCE: {味|あじ}わう implies careful, appreciative attention, not just casual tasting or experiencing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|た}べる - to eat (neutral)
- {試食|ししょく}する - to sample food
- {経験|けいけん}する - to experience (more neutral)
